name: Gastón Acurio
bio: Peruvian chef of Lima, who took ceviche and the native produce of Peru into fine dining and led the rise of Peruvian cuisine in the world.

milestones.event: Opened Astrid y Gastón in Lima with Astrid Gutsche.
Founded Mistura, the yearly food fair of Lima, to show Peruvian produce and cooks.
